simple.meaning: to cleave ; generally, to rend , break , rip or open
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּקַע (H1234) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 51 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בָּקַע (bâqaʻ) means to cleave ; generally, to rend , break , rip or open First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 18.

definitions.short: to cleave ; generally, to rend , break , rip or open
definitions.usage: make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.
definitions.full: H1234. baqa בָּקַע verb cleave, break open or through (Late Hebrew id. , MI 15 השחרת מבקע from break of dawn ; Aramaic בְּקַע ; compare Ethiopic profit, be useful , originally findere, aperire , Di) — Qal Perfect בָּקַע Psa 78:13 , בָּֽקְעָה Isa 34:15 , בָּקַעְתָּ Neh 9:11 ; Psa 74:15 , וּבָֽקַעְתָּ֫ Ezek 29:7 ; Imperfect וַיִּבְקַע Judg 15:19 ; Isa 48:21 , וַיִּבְקְעוּ 2Sam 23:16 = 1Chr 11:18 , בְקָעוּהָ וַיִּ 2Chr 21:17 ; Imperative וּבְקָעֵהוּ Exod 14:16 ; Infinitive construct suffix בִּקְעָם Amos 1:13 ; 2Chr 32:1 ; Participle active בּוֺקֵעַ Isa 63:12 ; Eccl 10:9 , בֹּקֵעַ Psa 141:7 ; — 1 cleave, cleave open , followed by accusative, Judg 15:19 God cleft open the hollow ( הַמֵּכְתֵּשׁ ), and water came out, compare Isa 48:21 (object צוּר ), also Psa 74:15 bring forth by cleaving , object יָנָחַ֑ל מַעְיָן , all three of divine operation; cleave or rip open pregnant women Amos 1:13 ; of a broken staff, tearing the shoulder Ezek 29:7 (but read כַּף hand for ᵑ9 ᵐ5 כָּתֵף, Sm (?)Co.); cleave wood Eccl 10:9 (|| אֲבָנִים מַסִּיעַ ); of ploughing (furrowing) the earth Psa 141:7 (|| מֹּלֵחֵ ; in simile); especially of dividing the sea, Exod 14:16 (P) Neh 9:11 ; Psa 78:13 , compare Isa 63:12 , object מַיִם ; — in all these subject ׳י except Exod 14:16 where he commands Moses; of hatching out (a brood, but no object expressed) Isa 34:15 , subject קִמּוֺו arrow-snake. 2 break through or into , followed by בְּ 2Sam 23:16 = 1Chr 11:18 ; followed by accusative 2Chr 21:17 וֵיִבְקָעוּהָ בִיהוּדָה וַיַעֲלוּ ; also 32:1 , object suffix reference to cities, אֵלָיו לְבִקְעָם ויאמר and he thought to break into them and so bring them unto himself . Niph`al Perfect נִבְקַע Job 26:8 ; Zech 14:4 ( וְ consecutive); נִבְקְעוּ Gen 7:11 ; Isa 35:6 , נִבְקָ֑עוּ 2Chr 25:11 ; Prov 3:20 ; Imperfect יִבָּקַע Isa 58:8 , יִבֵָּק֑עַ Job 32:19 ; 3 feminine singular תִּבָּקַע Isa 59:5 , וַתִּבָּקַע Num 16:31 3 t.; Infinitive construct לְהִבָּקֵעַ Ezek 30:16 ; — 1 be cleft, rent open , subject the ground, הָֽאֲדָמָה Num 16:31 (J), הָאָרֶץ 1Kin 1:40 (hyperb.); mountain Zech 14:4 ; burst open , of men hurled from rock 2Chr 25:12 ; of cloud beneath its weight of water Job 26:8 ; hyperb. of belly full of words seeking a vent, 32:19 like new wine-skins it will burst open ; so of the water-receptacles ( מעינות ) of the great deep, at the flood Gen 7:11 ; of the water-masses themselves, תהומות Prov 3:20 , ונהלים מים Isa 35:6 ; also of the Red Sea, המים וַיִבָּקְעוּ Exod 14:21 ; of light breaking forth Isa 58:8 (figurative); of serpent's egg hatching out as a viper 59:5 אֶפְעֶה תִּבָּקַע הַזּוּרֶה . 2 be broken into , of city captured by breaches in walls 2Kin 25:4 = Jer 52:7 ; Ezek 30:16 . Pi`el Perfect בִּקֵּעַ 2Kin 15:16 ; Job 28:10 , וּבִקַּעְתִּ֫י Ezek 13:13 , בִּקֵּ֑עוּ Isa 59:5 ; Imperfect יְבַקַּע Psa 78:15 , וַיְבַקַּע Gen 22:3 ; 3 feminine singular תְּבַקֵּעַ Ezek 13:11 , תְּבַקְּעֵם Hosea 13:8 ; 2 masculine singular תְּבַקַּעֿ Hab 3:9 , תְּבַקֵּ֑עַ 2Kin 8:12 ; 2 feminine plural וַתְּבַקַּעְנָה 2:24 ; — cleave, cut to pieces , or rend open (often more complete or more violent than Qal), followed by accusative, of cleaving wood Gen 22:3 i.e. cut it up for burning, so 1Sam 6:14 ; of ripping open pregnant women 2Kin 8:12 ; 15:16 ; of tearing in pieces children 2:24 ; compare also Hosea 13:8 (figurative); of cleaving open rocks, to bring forth water Psa 78:15 (subject God); of cutting mining-shafts Job 28:10 בּ יְאֹרִים ׳בַּצּוּרוֺת ; תְּבַקַּעאָֿ֑רֶץ נְהָרוֺת Hab 3:9 into rivers thou cleavest (the) earth; break through or down (a wall, but no object expressed), Ezek 13:11 תְּבֵַקּ֑עַ סְעָרוֺת רוּחַ (but Co תִּבָּקֵעַ ), compare 13:13 בַחֲמָתִי סְעָרוֺת רוּחַ וּבִקַּעְתִּי ; of hatching eggs Isa 59:5 צִפְעוֺנִיבִֵּקּ֑עוּ בֵּיצֵי (figurative) Pu`al Imperfect יְבָֻקּ֑עוּ Hosea 14:1 ; Participle מְבֻקָּעָה Ezek 26:10 , מְבֻקָּעִים Josh 9:4 ; — be ripped open , of women Hosea 14:1 (verb of masculine form); rent , of old wine-skins Josh 9:4 ; broken into , of a city in whose walls a breach has been made Ezek 26:10 . Hiph`il Imperfect 1plural suffix וְנַבְקִעֶנָּה Isa 7:6 ; Infinitive construct לְהַבְקִיעַ 2Kin 3:26 ; — break into , followed by suffix reference to Judah, Isa 7:6 ׳ונב אֵלֵינוּ let us break into it , lay it open, and so bring it unto ourselves (compare Qal 2Chr 32:1 ); break through (absolute) with sword, אֶלמֶֿלֶךְאֱדוֺם לְהַבְקִיעַ חֶרֶבּ שֹׁלֵף 2Kin 3:26 . Hoph`al Perfect 3feminine singular הָעִיר הָבְקְעָה Jer 39:2 the city was broken into , entrance was made by a breach. Hithpa`el Perfect הִתְכַָּקּ֑עוּ Josh 9:13 , Imperfect יִתְבּקָּ֑עוּ Micah 1:4 ; — burst (themselves) open , of wine-skins Josh 9:13 ; cleave asunder , of valleys Micah 1:4 .
